contexts: children's hospital transition clinic, about 400 young people a year
transition steering group revising the assessment
young people with learning disabilities and low health literacy
reading: The clinic uses a readiness score as a gate, but few tools have been tested for prediction (claim c1), and the one prospective study found no prediction of outcomes after transfer (claim c2). Young people describe readiness as confidence within relationships (claim c3), and scores partly track literacy and deprivation (claim c4). What predicted engagement was contact with adult clinicians, which points the review towards assessment as conversation and planning rather than threshold.

nodes.label: Engagement and disease control after transfer
nodes.detail: What the score is assumed to predict.

summary: Map shows the gap between how the score is used and what it has been shown to do.
